I grow barley on this 2.29 hectare plot that I rent here in Oromia. I will buy DAP and urea from the cooperative to put on the land—about 40 kilograms of nitrogen for each hectare—because barley needs it to produce well, though I cannot afford the full recommended package. I will also spread whatever manure and compost I have saved to help the soil. My family will put in most of the work, but I will hire around twenty-five days of help when weeding and harvest get heavy.
